original_test_intent: Use AGT power-management logging to prove GPU current and junction temperatures are readable and attributable during both idle and an approved stress condition.
original_method: Pin AGT, GPU map and pm.csv schema, capture a settled idle interval, start the approved bounded stress workload under watchdog and independent temperature/power/fan monitoring, run exact `./agt -pmlogall`, parse timestamped per-GPU current/junction data with units and freshness, enforce hard aborts, stop all processes and verify return to idle plus clean log delta.
manual_activity: GPU thermal owner approves workload, limits, sensor schema and abort/recovery policy and interprets idle/stress traces before verdict.
required_inputs: Signed AGT binary/hash and pm.csv schema
Stable GPU/sensor identity map and units
Approved idle settle and stress workload/duration/load oracle
Expected operating ranges and independent hard-abort limits
Watchdog, telemetry, protected output and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Stress only after limits, cooling and watchdog preflight
Monitor independent temperature, junction, power, fan and driver health
Reject stale, missing, duplicated, nonnumeric or unit-ambiguous samples
Abort on limit, reset, fan/power/driver/log or CSV-write anomaly
Stop workload/logger and prove safe idle recovery; never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect approved idle and one bounded stress trace locally
Parse freshness and correlate load with per-GPU sensors
Perform controlled cleanup and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve workload, duration, expected ranges and hard aborts
Approve sensor/field/unit mapping and evidence interpretation
Disposition excursions or missing data and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The remote generic invocation adds unsafe access and does not prove the source's pm.csv or an actual stress interval.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run verified local exact `./agt -pmlogall` across separately identified idle and approved stress windows, preserving the unique pm.csv and process/workload timestamps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Literal option and five-minute attendance/machine timing remain, subject to the approved bounded stress profile.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use unique output, monotonic timestamps and a joined table of workload utilization, AGT current/junction readings, independent telemetry and limits for idle and stress windows.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines 'readable' as fresh, numeric, unit-correct, target-bound and stress-correlated rather than merely present.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Idle-only output or unrelated BMC temperature cannot substitute for both AGT GPU sensor fields under approved load.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readability does not by itself validate sensor accuracy; any accuracy tolerance requires a calibrated reference outside this criterion.

project_override_considerations: Thermal owner defines safe workload and thresholds per cooling SKU/ambient; configuration-specific limits must be recorded rather than generalized.
expected_evidence: AGT hash/version, pm.csv schema and stable GPU/sensor map
Exact logger and stress argv, versions, timestamps and watchdog settings
Immutable raw pm.csv plus parsed per-GPU current/junction values with units/freshness
Idle/stress utilization and independent thermal/power/fan trace
Abort/limit evaluation, process cleanup and return-to-idle health/log delta

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requires AGT sensor logging at idle and stress; spelling errors do not change intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, schema, workload and limits are ordinary project inputs; static review can complete pending their provisioning.

review_improvement: Adds the missing stress execution, time alignment, freshness/unit checks and independent safety envelope while preserving the exact CSV-producing command.
independent_technical_reasoning: A sensor value can be syntactically readable yet stale, mapped to another GPU or unchanged because the workload never loaded the target. Correlating monotonic samples with per-GPU utilization distinguishes real idle/stress coverage. Since the test introduces stress risk, AGT telemetry cannot be its only safety oracle; independent monitoring and deterministic abort/cleanup are required.
